description: The IPC channel, a Unix domain socket in `/tmp` on Linux, through which the `dotnet-*` tools ask the runtime for counters, traces and dumps.
A tool that shows live runtime and ASP.NET Core metrics such as GC collections, heap size, thread-pool queue length and exception rate.
A tool that records an EventPipe trace of a running process, by default with GC, JIT and exception events plus sampled thread stacks.
A tool that captures only the managed heap graph, small to store but triggering a full gen 2 collection when collected.
A tool that collects a full or heap process dump and analyzes it with SOS commands, without a native debugger.
The SOS command that shows the chain of references from a GC root, such as a static field, to an object that is kept alive.
Running the tools in a second container that shares the app's process namespace and `/tmp` directory, so the app image needs no tools.
